svg.text: Laptop USB powers the ESP32; the ESP32 3V3 pin powers the display. The battery corner shows "USB".
Power path: Laptop USB -> ESP32 -> 3V3 pin -> display
No battery module, no divider and no capacitor in this version.
Wires that cross without a black dot are NOT connected.
ESP32 pins are shown grouped by use, not in board order.
